title: Grateful Dead Live at Community War Memorial Auditorium on 1982-04-09
lineage: Master Cassettes (Nakamichi CR-7A)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > Tascam Hi-Res Editor (.wav 24-bit/96k) > Adobe Audition CC 2025 > TLH flac2496
source: Bob Wagner's Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Sony TC-D5M (Maxell XLII-S90)

ai_review.summary: Excellent front‑of‑house soundboard capture of a high‑energy show highlighted by a scorching MSWS opener and a phenomenal Space > The Other One.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers crystal‑clear FOH sound that makes listeners feel like they’re right at the mixing console. The second set ignites with an unusually hot MSWS and builds to a mind‑blowing Space → The Other One sequence, showcasing the band at peak 80’s intensity.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed 5‑star review praises both the performance and the recording; high energy and excellent soundboard quality justify a top‑tier rating, but limited sample size keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Front‑of‑house mix captured with great clarity; reviewers say it sounds like you're standing at the FOH, indicating a crisp and balanced recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set launched strong with a hot MSWS and escalated into an electrifying Space → The Other One, maintaining momentum and excitement throughout.
